# Atlas (2024 film)
*Atlas* is a science fiction film set in 2043, where humanoid AI terrorist Harlan initiates a war against humanity. Twenty-eight years later in 2071, Atlas Shepherd, an analyst with deep distrust of AI and the daughter of Harlan's designer, searches for the fugitive Harlan. Following a mission to capture him using AI-assisted mecha called ARCs, Atlas is forced to pilot an ARC herself after her Rangers' ship is attacked by Harlan's drones and crashes on a distant planet.
While on the planet, Atlas begins to bond with the ARC's onboard AI, Smith, and learns that Harlan killed her mother. After Harlan extracts security codes from Atlas's brain, she is left with Colonel Banks. Atlas reactivates Smith, upgrades the AI using salvaged parts, and together they fight Harlan, ultimately defeating him in hand-to-hand combat, though Atlas is badly injured. Back on Earth, Atlas tests a new ARC model whose AI repeats a phrase from the mission's climax, suggesting Smith's sentience survived.

# Critical Reception and Release
The film was released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, debuting at number one on the platform's most popular English films list. Critically, *Atlas* was generally not well-received, earning a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a score of 37 out of 100 on Metacritic.
